company.name: Artistic Visual Agency
company.distributes: Imported chocolates, sweets and snacks (Reese's, Hershey's, M&M's, Twizzlers, Warheads, Nerds, Airheads), plus drinks and groceries
company.channels_supplied: Retailers, wholesalers, convenience stores, foodservice partners and independent businesses in South Africa and neighbouring markets
what_they_do_well: Exclusive agent in South Africa for Reese's, Joyride and Sparkling Ice, according to its website.
company.fit_rationale: Wholesale and distribution business for imported FMCG brands, led by confectionery and snacks, supplying both retailers and other wholesalers. It names itself exclusive agent for brands such as Reese's and Joyride and publishes a trade catalogue. Storage: wholesales from its own stock in Halfway House, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: BAIRO Group GmbH
company.distributes: Snacks and sweets (chips, candy, cookies, chocolate), drinks, energy drinks, groceries and non-food kiosk supplies.
company.channels_supplied: Kiosks, petrol station shops, retailers and foodservice in Switzerland and Liechtenstein, B2B web shop with 2 to 5 day delivery.
what_they_do_well: Runs a B2B shop for kiosks, petrol station shops, retailers and foodservice across Switzerland and Liechtenstein.
company.fit_rationale: A B2B wholesaler built around the kiosk and petrol shop channel with a dedicated snacks and sweets category, delivering nationwide including Basel. Sugar free chocolate and sweets would give its kiosk customers a differentiated line.

company.name: Gift Lady
company.distributes: Chocolate hampers, coffee, tea and cookies hampers, gourmet snack hampers and a diabetic-friendly hamper with sugar-free chocolate and sweets
company.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers nationwide and corporate gift hampers for businesses
company.sf_brands_carried: Chocwell sugar-free chocolate and Little Lovies sugar-free candies in its diabetic-friendly hamper
what_they_do_well: Already sells a diabetic-friendly hamper built on branded sugar-free chocolate and sweets.
company.fit_rationale: An established online gift and hamper shop that already sells a diabetic-friendly hamper filled with other brands' sugar-free chocolate and sweets, so it knows the buyer Diablo serves. Its chocolate, cookie and corporate year-end hampers give Diablo several places to sit. It already carries Chocwell, a direct sugar-free chocolate competitor.

company.name: Savemore Group
company.distributes: Biscuits, sweets and snacks from brands such as Chappies, Maynards, Lay's and Doritos, alongside groceries, beverages and household goods
company.channels_supplied: Wholesale and retail trade through cash and carry branches in Pretoria, Gqeberha, Qonce (King William's Town) and Kariega (Uitenhage), plus online ordering
what_they_do_well: Serving the wholesale and retail trade since 2001, with branches in Pretoria and the Eastern Cape.
company.fit_rationale: A multi-branch cash and carry wholesaler that resells branded biscuits, sweets and snacks to the trade in Gauteng and the Eastern Cape. Its warehouse service covering Gauteng, Mpumalanga and Free State gives Diablo reach into independent stores in several provinces. Storage: cash and carry branches and a warehouse service named on its website.

company.name: Triple X Fitness Shop GmbH (online-nutrition.ch)
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Protein and muesli bars, protein cookies, cake pastries, chocolate (including Mars, Snickers and M&M's protein lines), spreads and sugar-free syrups, alongside sports supplements
company.channels_supplied: Its own Triple X Fitness Store at Löwenstrasse 5 in Lucerne and its online shop shipping across Switzerland and Liechtenstein
company.sf_brands_carried: Barebells, Quest, Grenade, Mars and Snickers Hi Protein Low Sugar bars; Inlead sugar-free Choc Drops; a Sugarfree Sirup category
what_they_do_well: Runs a physical sports nutrition store in central Lucerne plus a national online shop shipping across Switzerland and Liechtenstein.
Carries a wide branded range including Barebells, ESN, More Nutrition, Optimum Nutrition, Quest and Grenade.
company.fit_rationale: A Lucerne city centre sports nutrition store with an online shop whose Protein Bars and Snacks, Aufstriche and Sugarfree Sirup categories carry other companies' bars, cookies, chocolate, spreads and syrups. Its health-conscious shoppers already buy low sugar snacks, so Diablo's bars, cookies, spreads and syrups fit its shelf directly. Note: Inlead sugar-free chocolate drops and sugar-free syrups compete with Diablo.
